description_en: Obtain the operation results of binding and detaching IP addresses from an address pool
description_zh: 获取IP地址与连接地址池绑定与解绑的操作结果
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc get-connection-pool-ip-operation-result --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --connection-pool-id cp-0gd9qnmv8431rh0000 --query-request-id CFA63CEB-15B6-4AE8-B203-F855FF7BA962 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetConnectionPoolIpOperationResult

parameters.help_en:
The region ID where the cloud connector instance resides.

You can obtain the region ID by invoking the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html API
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The request ID used for the query. This is the RequestId returned after successfully invoking the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313334.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313335.html API
parameters.help_zh: 查询请求ID，即调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313334.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313335.html接口，操作成功后返回的**RequestId**
parameters.name: query_request_id

ResultFilePaths.description_en:
The OSS file URLs containing the execution results of the attach and detach operations. These are the download URLs for the result files returned after invoking the [AssociateIpWithConnectionPool]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313334.html） or [DissociateIpFromConnectionPool]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313335.html） API. The URL format is `https://<BucketName.oss domain name>/ipma/<result file>?<expiration info>&<temporary AK/SK info>&<signature info>`.

The file content includes a list of failed IP addresses or error reasons for the attach and detach operations. If this field is empty, it indicates that there are no failure records
ResultFilePaths.description_zh:
绑定与解绑的执行结果文件地址，即调用[AssociateIpWithConnectionPool]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313334.html）或[DissociateIpFromConnectionPool]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313335.html）接口执行结果文件下载地址。格式为0。

文件内容为绑定和解绑的错误IP地址或错误原因列表，如果该字段为空，代表没有失败记录
